balls.text: run out, tries to be a little too smart, slower one bowled on a good length on the off, tries to reverse-paddle it, misses and Shah throws down the stumps on the attempted single to prevent Punjab from hitting six-an-over
short on middle, swats it in front of square, mistimed again, and only manages a single
mistimes it for four, full on middle and leg, tried to drill it down the ground, hit the inside half of the bat and had enough on it to beat midwicket to the boundary, important runs these
full on the off, dragged towards deep midwicket, Tiwary is onto it quickly and prevents the second
a couple more, slower ball bowled full on leg stump, struck away wide of Zaheer at long-on, a wayward throw at the striker's end but he is through comfortably
length ball, got under it nicely, made way and swung it away between long-on and deep midwicket
fullish on leg stump, pushed short of midwicket for a quick single to keep the strike for the final over
slower one, bowled it at 124.4 kmph, made room and was into the shot a little too early, was fortunate to get an inside edge onto his pads and sneak a single
effort delivery, attempted yorker, bowled at 137.9 kmph, makes room and steers it to point
short on middle, tries to pull it away but came onto him too quickly, was a touch too high as well, dot ball
an inswinging yorker on leg stump, dug out towards long-on
full on the off stump, tries to clear long-off, mistimes it, gets a single
short of a length outside off, tries to swat it over the infield on the leg side, gets a thin edge just short of the keeper
full outside off, tries to paddle it fine, doesn't connect, brushes the pads on the way to short fine
swinging into the right hander, lands full on leg stump, flicked away to fine leg
slower offcutter, bowled at 115 kmph, came down the track and tried to run it down, missed
in the blockhole, on the off stump, dug out behind point, brings up the 100, what a struggle it has been
short of a good length outside off, guided down to third man for a single
mixing it up beautifully here, slower on on leg stump, at 114.2 kmph, turned away towards deep square leg, picked it at the last moment
another yorker, on the off stump, dug out back to the bowler, this is some spell, has just conceded six runs so far
lethal yorker, Chawla had no answer to that one, fired in at close to 140 kmph, failed to get his bat down, was done in by the pace and the offstump goes for a stroll
slower ball on the off, short of a good length, an offcutter, tries to run it down, misses
timber, attempted yorker again, misdirected though, going down leg but Mota makes way and tries to flick it away on the leg side, misses, the ball clips his pads and crashes into the stumps
yorker, but concedes four, too quick for Mota, doesn't get his bat down in time, just misses leg stump and Shah fails to cut that off diving to his left, the extras grow
angling it into the right hander, on middle and leg, turned short of fine leg for a single
saves a couple, for the second time, Dhawan has fielded well, run down wide of him at third man and he dives full length to his left to drag it back in

appeal for run out, just made it, driven straight to Saurabh Tiwary at the edge of the circle at extra cover and sets off, a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Sanga has stretched hard to just drag it in
yorker on middle, at 128.6 kmph, didn't spot it early but did well to dig it out back to the bowler
short outside off, stands tall and guides it delicately to third man
short of a good length on the off, punched off the front foot to long-off
starts off with a wide, poor stuff, they've bowled too many of them today, down the leg side
slower one bowled short on leg stump, tried to pull it fine, mistimed it and salvaged a single wide of square leg
in the blockhole, bowled at 133.6 kmph on middle, dug out back to the bowler
short of a length on middle, works it away wide of square leg for a single, off the mark

struck well, but again, finds the fielder, banged in short on middle, Irfan is onto it quickly, gets forward and pulls it away straight to a perfectly positioned Bravo at deep midwicket, Punjab are sliding here
on middle and leg, dropped short of midwicket and they scamper off
driven into the off side just at the edge of the circle for a single
down the leg side, an attempted slower one gone bad, tries to help it fine, the keeper fumbles, two more
length ball again, meaty, on leg stump, pushed short of midwicket for a quick single to keep the strike
attempted yorker, ends up being a low full toss on leg stump, turned away to deep midwicket
full length on middle, flicked away to deep square leg, one more
beauty, length ball on the off and swings away at the last moment to beat the outside edge as he tries to drive through the line
quick, bowled at 136.4 kmph, pushed down to long-on for a single
called a wide, down the leg side, tries to glance it fine, misses, but earns an extra ball
fullish on the off, on target straightaway, pushed wide of cover for a single
short of a good length outside off, gets back and slaps it to deep cover
this is proving expensive, fires it in down the leg side, Irfan misses out on the sweep, Shah doesn't get his body behind it, it rolls down the fine-leg boundary, five runs
gets forward and works it away in front of square for a single
finally, flighted on middle comes down the track and strikes it cleanly over the bowler's head, timed beautifully
superb fielding, driven powerfully wide of long-off but Dhawan dives full length to his right to save a couple of runs
flights it up this time, charges down but is not to the pitch, fends it away into the off side
quicker one bowled short on middle, punched back to the bowler
the straighter one, short on the off, dabbed short of cover and they're off
swept to Jayasuriya at short fine, he fires in a throw at the non-striker's end but the batsman's well in
flighted on middle, drifting in towards leg, tries to clip it away, is struck on the pads
punched off the front foot wide of long-on for a single
short and wide, reaches and mistimes a cut to deep cover
flighted on the off, lunges forward and pushes it down the ground to long-off
low full toss on the off, pushed through the line to long-off again
flighted on the off, fuller in length, driven down to long-off
swept wide of short fine leg for a single

a wicket right after the tactical break, for the umpteenth time, low full toss on the off stump, Mahela swings hard, connects well but it's flat, Dhawan moves a couple of yards to his right and takes a well-judged catch
straight on middle, tickled into the leg side for a single
firing it in on middle, three Sri Lankans into the act now, worked away off the front foot wide of midwicket
that was seam-up, short on middle, had no trouble getting back and whipping it to fine leg
tickled fine, wide of his team-mate Jayasuriya at short fine, for a quick single
much fuller on leg stump, nurdled wide of square leg, not exciting, but it's tough out there
on middle and leg, strikes him high on the pads as he tries to work it away, one more
quicker one down the leg side, given a wide
slightly short, rocks back and cuts it behind point, not firmly, though he should have, just a single
offspinner, tossed up outside off, flicks it wide of midwicket, it's in the gap and they get back for the second
on middle and off, gets front and across and nudges it wide of square leg to keep the strike
short of a length outside off, quickish again, left alone

excellent catch, struck powerfully but flat, it was bowled a touch quicker on leg stump and he stepped out to cart that in the direction of long-on, didn't get much elevation and Zaheer ran a few steps to his right, dived forward and plucked a sharp chance
slower through the air, on middle and off, defended off the back foot
flighted outside leg stump, swept straight to Tendulkar at short fine
pushed away into the leg side wide of midwicket for a single
tossed it up and Sanga too full toll, stepping out of the crease and creaming it between long-off and deep cover, that should ease the pressure a little
low full toss on the off stump, swatted down to long-on
fullish on the off, driven down the ground to long-off
on middle and leg, swept away wide of square leg for a single
Punjabi to Punjabi, short and wide, kept a little low as he tried to cut, failed to get his bat down
full on the pads, slaps it towards deep square, six singles, Mumbai won't mind this at all
quicker, short outside off, chopped down wide of point for one more
short of a length on middle, whipped away off the back foot wide of midwicket
keeping it tight, short on middle, paddled towards deep square leg again
flat on leg stump, nudged wide of short fine for a single
takes it from outside off, sweeps it down to backward square leg for a single
the straighter one, on middle, gets back and punches it down towards deep cover
quicker one bowled flat and full on middle, driven firmly wide of mid-on for a single
drew hi forward with the flight, reaches and pushes it to cover
quicker, angling into leg stump, gets across and tries to work it away, lobs off the pads behind square for a single
short again, coming on slowly though, rocks back and cuts it to point
tossed up, short outside off and spinning, bunts it straight to cover
picked the length early, short on middle, came down the track and pulled it in front of square, wide of mid-on for a boundary
on middle and off, gets on the back foot and defends short of point, calls for a single but is sent back
good length outside off, much closer to the stumps, Yuvraj lets it go
too wide, getting some good movement away from the batsman, a little too wide, called
another bowling change, and another breakthrough! Poor short, good length outside off and moving away, drives at it hard, gets a thick edge and Tendulkar at a widish slip snaps a dolly
short and wide, leaves the right hander as he tries to slash at it, the pressure's building
gets on the back foot to defend, slightly short on the off, gets a thick inside edge towards square leg
tossed up on the off stump, eased it to cover off the front foot

stumped, beaten by the flight, he hadn't gave it too much air this over, and saved it for the end of the over, Goel's eyes lit up, was drawn out of the crease, missed his attempt to clear long-on as the ball spun away and Pinal Shah did the rest
that had to happen, their patience was being tested and Goel couldn't take it anymore, flat on middle, swatted it away with ferocity over deep midwicket
round the wicket, angling into the left hander, defended watchfully
on middle and leg, gets across and bunts it wide of mid-on for a single
slightly short on the off stump and spinning away, drops it wide of slip, behind point, for a single
straying on the pads, nurdles it behind square for one more, one of these guys need to open up now
good bounce, short of a good length and jumped off the pitch to beat the outside edge as the tried to edge that past the keeper
on middle and leg, tickled behind square for a single, taking their time these two
shaping away from the right hander, bowled on a length on the off, at 134.8 kmph, defended back to the bowler
another run, taps it short of midwicket off the back foot and scampers through for a single
slower one on the off stump, drops it short of square leg and sets off
follows that up with a lethal yorker, Geol is prepared though, waits for it and brings his bat down to dig it out short of cover
deceived by the slower one, bowled at 114.6 kmph, an offcutter that spat away and Goel did well to take his bottom hand off and negotiate
back of a length on the off, much slower, drops it down with soft hands behind point for a single
chases it, short and wide, slashes at it, misses as it swings away
decent pace first up, at 135.2 kmph, pushed him back again, defended to the bowler
short on the off, gets back and drops it on the leg side, defended solidly
short of a good length on the off, gets back and drops it towards point
on middle and leg, gets across and works it away behind square for a couple, he's away
short of a good length outside off, guided down to third man
quick single, gets forward and just dabs it short of mid-on
appeal for lbw, landed on a good length outside leg and moved back in to rap him on the pads, he was just half-forward, got an inside edge, but it can't be given, we know why
loosener outside off, full, opens the face and squeezes that to point
creamed through the of side but Powar flings himself to his right at cover to save a couple of runs and seal a thrilling win for Punjab
full outside off, driven wide of a diving cover for a couple, hit well and it's down to one hit
that's the match!! A difference of two inches! In the slot outside off, swipes it powerfully but straight to the substitute fielder Taruwar Kohli at deep midwicket
short of a length, pulled away wide of long-on for a couple more, didn't time it well, keeps the strike though
concedes a wide, too wide, too short outside off, he lets it go and earns a run
misses the slower one outside off, goes for a massive pull, it's short, misses out, too early into the shot
short outside off, swatted down the ground wide of long-on, wayward throw at the striker's end, two taken
on middle and leg, dropped short of square leg for a single to keep the strike in the final over
lucky, slices it well over cover, three men converging in but it lands safe, two more
dabbed short of cover for a quick single to give the senior man the strike
full outside off, charges down and slices it wide of long-off for a couple, the ball spins away from Mahela
tossed up outside off, reverse-swept wide of point for a single
the change works, you beauty! Flat and wide outside off, charges down the track and swats it wide of long-off where Goel runs across and snaps a crucial catch just inside the ropes
Harbhajn almost threw it away, full outside off, moved across to paddle, got an inside edge onto his pads and fell just short of Pathan
short on the off stump, moved across and pulled it down to deep midwicket, kept it down, 100 up for Mumbai, good fightback
good length outside off, just a firm push, raced away to deep cover, Harbhajan's gifted, sweetly timed
swings and misses, short of a length outside off, slower one, was too early into the shot, didn't pick it
he's squeezed a boundary, yorker on the off stump from round the wicket, comes down the track to dig it out, gets an outside edge and that rolls wide of Abdulla at third man for a crucial four
Nayar, what have you done?? Full on leg stump, a yorker, tried to get under it and smack it over midwicket, missed and timber!
nicely done, flighted on the off, punched hard wide of long-off for a couple to get to his 50, superb innings but his job is way incomplete
short on leg stump, pulled away to deep square leg, good tight over this
gets across and drops it short of point for a quick single
tossed up on middle, struck away in the leg side towards deep square leg for a single
good length outside off, made room and had a go, missed, and it just evaded the off stump
short of a length on the off, tapped into the off side for a quick single
excellent shot but a diving stop at cover keeps them down to single, palms it to deep cover, but he saved at least a couple there
back of a length on the off, punched past the bowler to mid-off for another quick single
slower one bowled on a length, eased through to deep cover
full on middle, tries to whip it away, gets an inside edge onto his pads and they scamper through
short of a good length on the off, dabbed into the off side, calls for a single and then decides against it
full outside off, moves across and swipes that over midwicket for a couple, a diving stop by Vikramjeet Malik running to his left from long-on
too wide outside off, another wide, another run, poor stuff

missed run out, gets the outside edge as he tries to work that away into the leg side, a huge mix up in the middle of the pitch as Duminy calls for a single but sends Nayar back midway through the run, there's no one to gather the throw at the non-striker's end and the damage is averted
tries to be a little too cheeky there its full outside off, tries to paddle it wide of short fine, misses
slower one dropped short outside off, backs away from it this time
excellent running, short of a length outside off, dabbed wide of third man at just the last moment for two more
short outside leg stump, tries to help it fine, goes off his thighs wide of fine leg for a couple more
superb shot, slower one outside off, waited for it, bent low and guided it delicately wide of the keeper to the third-man boundary, he's the key man
shot, much slower, on middle, swept away powerfully between deep square leg and  deep midwicket for a pressure-relieving boundary
missed stumping, quicker one on a good length outside off, held its line, tried to force it through the off side, missed, and the keeper couldn't bend low in time to effect a dismissal
another dot ball, played towards point, a single averted and Duminy's under pressure
quicker one bowled full outside off, dug out to cover
tossed up outside off, gets outside the line to sweep, is struck on the pads
quicker one bowled full outside off, swept down to deep square leg

misfield at cover, went through his legs, short outside off and smashes it hard, a valiant attempt to stop it at deep cover but his body is in contact with the ropes as he tries to drag it back, good over for Mumbai
quicker through the air, on leg stump, tickled straight to short fine
low full toss on the off, swept down to deep square leg
flighted on middle, driven down the ground to long-on, too slow through the air, but played it all along the ground
down the leg side, didn't spin back in enough, the keeper missed it too, so two more to the score
quick single, dropped short of point and Nayar calls, Mahela fails to pick it up cleanly
short of a length outside off, cut away wide of deep cover for a couple
low full toss on the off, driven down the ground to long-off for a single
three chances to score missed, short outside off, goes for a mighty pull over midwicket, misses
slower one, bowled on a good length, driven firmly wide of long-off for a couple
another dot ball, on middle and off, pushed straight to cover
misses out again, bowled at 124 kmph, tried to cut it wide,will regret not being able to connect
medium pace, short outside off, tries to chop it down, misses
flighted outside leg stump, swept down to deep square leg, one more, Duminy has looked fluent here
tossed up on middle, gets forward, closes the face and works it into the vacant leg-side field for a single
eased through wide of point on the front foot for a single
quicker outside off, went straight on, bunts it to deep cover
short outside off, cut away to deep point for a single
short outside off, spinning away sharply, too wide, called one
flighted outside off, opens the face, tries to squeeze it past point, fails to beat the fielder
on middle and leg, defended off the front foot to cover
drives it back past Powar to long-on for a single
tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler on the front foot
flighted on leg stump, pushed wide of midwicket for a single

he's holed out, was tempted with the flight, came down the track and tried to clear long-on, but didn't strike it well enough, Wilkin Mota was waiting at long-on and though it appeared for a while that it would beat him, he stayed focused to take it well into his palms
flighted on the off, dropped short of point and races off
good clean strike, gave it some air, also had a bit of pace on it, came down the track, got under it and deposited it over long-off, well done
went straight on, outside off, defended to cover
Bravo breaks the shackles, short on middle, a rank long hop, rocks back and pulls it away in that massive gap between long-on and deep midwicket
short of a length on leg stump, dropped short of short fine for a quick single
short on middle, punched off the back foot to long-on
skid off the pitch, got back and tickled it fine but only just, was a little late on the shot, and had he missed, he was plumb
tossed up on middle, gets it wider this time, pushes it wide of long-on for a couple
wristy, almost flicks it straight to midwicket, falls just short, it's tossed up outside off and he'll consider himself fortunate for not timing that well
tossed up outside off, moves across and defends on the pitch, the run-rate is creeping
quicker one on middle, punched past cover for a single
short outside off, struck to cover, he fields well reaching to his right, saved a couple there
short of a length outside off, was spinning away, tried to cut it hard past point, chopped it wide of the keeper and short third for a couple
pushed on the off stump, punched to cover off the front foot
slower one outside off, too short, and too wide, a run gifted, they don't seem to have learnt from the mistakes Mumbai made here, quite a few wides already
slower one on the off, was into the shot a little too early, mistimed it to midwicket
back of a length, wide enough for him to leave
straying on the pads, tries to tickle it fine, clips his thighs, the keeper dives, palms it with his gloves, they get a leg bye
short of a length on the off, punched through to deep cover
fullish outside off and moves away, left alone to the keeper
back of a length on the off, pushes it short of mid-on and steals a single, good over for Mumbai, will ease the nerves a bit
good length on the off, defends with a straight bat to mid-on
sliding on middle and leg, bringing it back in, dropped short of midwicket for a quick single
four more, beautifully done, full on middle and leg, drives it back past the bowler, was a little uppish but sweetly struck
finally, just a fraction short, not to the pitch at all but opens the face to steer that between point and cover, nicely timed
short on leg stump, tries to turn it fine, misses
timed well but straight to the fielder, full and wide, punched to cover, another successful over
angling it into the right hander, bowled at 118 kmph, the slower one there, defended off the back foot short of cover
too wide this time, short, Bravo lets it go and earns a run
back of a length outside off, held its line this time, left alone
much shorter, wide again, restrains himself from playing the cut
good length outside off and moving away, bowled at 136 kmph, left alone
Mumbai are sliding here, yorker on middle, he was down on it really late, hit his foot on the full and was struck in line with middle and leg
wasted again, too short outside off, spins away, would have been a wide had he left it, missed out, slaps it straight to cover
short on middle, tries to punch it through cover, mistimes it, the pressure builds
really slow through the air, length on middle and spinning towards off, nudged to cover
tossed up outside off, driven off the front foot to cover, got to the pitch
flighted on middle, swept down behind square for a single
tossed up outside off, spins away, slaps it wide of Yusuf Abdulla at mid-off for three runs
back of a length on middle, pushes him back, defends it to the bowler
trying to probe him outside off, gets across and tries to push it towards midwicket, is hit on the thighs
good length on the off, moves across and defends it down the leg side
short of a good length outside off and moving away, pushed on the rise to cover
short and wide, cuts it away to third man, was in the air for a while
straying on the pads, tickled behind square for a single
driving length, gets forward and pushes that firmly to cover
angling into middle and leg, a hint of inswing, glanced down to fine leg for a single
moved back in, good length on middle and came back in, struck him on the thighs as he leaned forward
back of a length on middle, defended solidly off the back foot to the bowler
gone, the openers are out, short and wide, tempted into the cut, slashes it straight to Jayawardene at point, game on!
slower one bowled short outside off, misses out as he mistimes a pull to midwicket, no damage done
oversteps, short on the off, pushed towards the bowler off the back foot
back of a length on middle, gets back and defends it to the bowler
short outside of, opens the face, gets a thick edge just wide of point for a single
ooh, almost, much fuller, meaty length on the off, pushed at it, came back in to take the inside edge
back of a length outside off, just a hint of inward movement, left alone
short on middle and leg, turned away to fine leg for a single
edged and gone! Short of a good length on the off and swung away, jumped up at Jayasuriya, he pokes at it, gets a thick edge and Yuvraj takes it in front of his face at slip
down the leg side, one run gifted, Mumbai are away
